title: Paul sends word for Silas and Timothy to join him quickly
speaker: Paul
recipient: Silas and Timothy, via the escorts returning from Athens
topic: Historical commissions, journeys and public life
note: Outside candidate list (Acts 17:4–26 falls between batches). 17:14: the Berean brothers send Paul off toward the sea.

title: Receive the word eagerly and examine the Scriptures daily, like the Bereans
speaker: Luke, the narrator
recipient: readers; the Berean Jews as example
note: Outside candidate list; the narrator commends the Bereans as noble-minded. Example-based Wisdom like AUD-48-4-32.

title: Thessalonian officials take security from Jason before releasing the accused
speaker: the city officials of Thessalonica
note: Outside candidate list; the charge of acting against Caesar's decrees (17:7) is answered with a surety bond.

title: God made the nations to seek Him and now commands repentance
speaker: Paul at the Areopagus
note: 17:27–28 state God's purpose that people seek and find Him; same speech unit leading to the 17:30 command.

title: Ephesian believers write asking the Achaian disciples to welcome Apollos
speaker: the brothers at Ephesus
topic: Historical commissions, journeys and public life
note: Outside candidate list; a letter of recommendation, compare AUD-49-16-1 (Phoebe) and AUD-50-16-10 (Timothy).

title: Paul sends Timothy and Erastus ahead to Macedonia
speaker: Paul
note: 19:22 is outside candidate list; 19:21 gives Paul's Spirit-led resolve to go to Jerusalem and then Rome.

title: Renounce magic openly, as the Ephesian believers burned their books
speaker: Luke, the narrator
recipient: readers; the Ephesian believers as example
note: Outside candidate list; confession and burning of magic books as a model of repentance.

title: Disciples and friendly Asiarchs urge Paul not to enter the theater
speaker: the disciples and some Asiarchs
topic: Historical commissions, journeys and public life
note: Reported restraint and urging, like AUD-48-21-4 (disciples urge Paul not to enter Jerusalem).

title: Paul tells the Troas believers not to be alarmed over Eutychus
speaker: Paul
note: Spoken as Paul embraces the fallen young man, who is restored; compare AUD-48-9-36 (Tabitha, rise).

title: Paul summons the Ephesian elders to meet him at Miletus
speaker: Paul
recipient: the elders of the church at Ephesus
note: Reported summons that occasions the Miletus charge (AUD-48-20-24, A062).

title: Declare God's whole purpose and shepherd the flock as Paul did
speaker: Paul
topic: Major Teachings: The Word of Christ Handed On
note: Outside candidate list; 20:26–27 (clean from all blood, whole purpose declared) is the example 20:31 tells them to remember.

title: Covet no one's goods; work with your hands to help the weak
speaker: Paul, recalling the words of the Lord Jesus
topic: Major Teachings: The Word of Christ Handed On
note: Outside candidate list; 20:33–34 is the example that 20:35 'in this way' applies. 20:32 is a commendation, out of scope.

title: Tribune orders Paul bound with two chains and taken to the barracks
speaker: Claudius Lysias, the tribune
note: 21:34 (outside candidate list) adds the order to bring Paul into the barracks.

title: Jews from Asia rouse the crowd to seize Paul in the temple
speaker: Jews from Asia
recipient: the men of Israel at the temple
note: Outside candidate list; 'Men of Israel, help!' with the charge of bringing Greeks into the temple.

title: Paul asks the tribune for permission to address the people
speaker: Paul
note: Request granted at 21:40; Paul then asks the crowd to hear his defense (22:1).

title: The crowd demands that Paul be removed from the earth
speaker: the Jerusalem crowd
note: Repeats the cry 'Away with him!' (21:36, outside candidate list).

title: The tribune orders the chief priests and council to assemble
speaker: the tribune
recipient: the chief priests and the whole council
note: Convened to learn the accusation; Paul is set before them (23:1–10).

title: The high priest Ananias orders Paul struck on the mouth
speaker: Ananias the high priest
note: Paul protests that the order violates the law (23:3); 23:4–5 is already linked to C0209.

title: The tribune orders troops to snatch Paul from the divided council
speaker: the tribune

title: Conspirators vow to kill Paul and ask the council to summon him
speaker: more than forty Jewish conspirators
note: Includes their oath under a curse to neither eat nor drink (23:12–14); AUD-48-23-16 begins when the plot is disclosed.

title: Felix orders Paul held in Herod's praetorium until his accusers arrive
speaker: Felix the governor

title: Lysias's letter sends Paul to Felix and orders the accusers there
speaker: Claudius Lysias, the tribune
recipient: Felix; Paul's accusers; the escorting soldiers
note: Outside candidate list; the letter (23:25–30) orders accusers to state their case before Felix; soldiers act 'according to their orders' (23:31).

title: Tertullus asks Felix to hear the accusation briefly and examine Paul
speaker: Tertullus the advocate
note: Courtroom requests (24:4, 24:8); the surrounding verses are outside candidate list.

title: Accusers ought to appear before the judge and state their charge
speaker: Paul
note: Paul invokes the norm Festus states at 25:16, that accusers face the accused.

title: Strive always for a blameless conscience toward God and people
speaker: Paul
note: Outside candidate list; Paul's stated rule of life (compare 23:1).

title: Felix sends Paul away, then summons him often hoping for a bribe
speaker: Felix the governor
note: Paul's subjects (righteousness, self-control, coming judgment) are reported without quoted directives.

title: The chief priests ask Festus to bring Paul to Jerusalem
speaker: the chief priests and leading Jews
note: A favor requested to set an ambush on the road; Festus declines (25:4).

title: Festus tells the Jewish leaders to accuse Paul at Caesarea
speaker: Festus
recipient: the influential men among the Jews
note: Includes his order to bring Paul before the tribunal (25:6), retold by Festus at 25:17.

title: Festus recounts Paul's appeal and orders him held for Caesar
speaker: Festus
note: Retelling of 25:9–12, adding Festus's order to keep Paul in custody until he can be sent.

title: Festus brings Paul before Agrippa to find charges to write
speaker: Festus, at King Agrippa's request
recipient: King Agrippa and the assembled hearers
note: Agrippa asks to hear Paul (25:22); Paul is brought in at Festus's order (25:23).

title: Paul asks King Agrippa to hear him patiently
speaker: Paul
note: Agrippa grants leave to speak (26:1).

title: The risen Jesus confronts Saul: hard to kick against the goads
speaker: the risen Jesus
note: Outside candidate list; third Damascus account (22:6–11 already linked), adding the proverb about kicking against goads.

title: Paul proclaims: repent, turn to God, do works worthy of repentance
speaker: Paul
recipient: Jews of Damascus, Jerusalem and Judea, and the Gentiles
note: Paul's obedience to the vision (AUD-48-26-15); compare AUD-44-3-7 and AUD-48-3-17.

title: Paul warns the ship's company against sailing on from Fair Havens
speaker: Paul
recipient: the centurion, pilot, shipowner and crew
topic: Historical commissions, journeys and public life
note: 27:9–11 outside candidate list; at 27:21 Paul recalls the unheeded advice before AUD-48-27-22.

title: Paul calls the leading Jews of Rome together to hear him
speaker: Paul
topic: Historical commissions, journeys and public life
note: 28:17 and 28:21–23 outside candidate list; they ask to hear his views and appoint a day.

title: Paul, debtor to Greeks and non-Greeks, is eager to proclaim in Rome
speaker: Paul
note: Restates the obligation of the 1:1–6 commission; 1:7–12 is greeting and thanksgiving, needing nothing.

title: Paul calls same-sex intercourse dishonorable and contrary to nature
speaker: Paul
note: Allusion to Leviticus 18:22, not a quotation, within an indictment of idolatry; link only if the catalogue cross-references such teaching.

title: Do not practise or approve what God's righteous decree condemns
speaker: Paul
note: Vice list (including disobedience to parents) under God's decree that such deserve death; a doctrinal indictment, so borderline.

title: Not hearers but doers of the law are righteous before God
speaker: Paul
topic: Major Teachings: The Word of Christ Handed On
note: Same principle as James 1:22–25: be doers of the word, not hearers only.

title: Do not teach others the law while breaking it yourself
speaker: Paul
recipient: the one who bears the name Jew and teaches the law
note: 2:21–22 are linked only as commandments (S072, S025); the hypocrisy rebuke and 2:24 (Isaiah 52:5) are unrecorded.

title: Do not do evil so that good may come
speaker: Paul
note: Paul rejects the slogan as slander and calls its proponents' condemnation just; compare 6:1–2.

title: Blessed are those whose lawless deeds are forgiven
speaker: David, quoted by Paul
note: Beatitude quoting Greek Psalm 31:1–2, also unrecorded; link there instead if the Psalms review itemizes it.

title: Boast in afflictions, which produce perseverance, character and hope
speaker: Paul
topic: Major Teachings: The Word of Christ Handed On
note: Same teaching as James 1:2–4 (trials produce endurance), though phrased as 'we boast'.

title: Do not remain in sin so that grace may increase
speaker: Paul
note: 6:1–2 rejects continuing in sin, the premise of the 6:11–14 directive; 6:3–4 has study record A006.

title: Paul quotes 'the person who does these things will live by them'
speaker: Moses, quoted by Paul
note: Quotation of Leviticus 18:5 (also quoted at Galatians 3:12).

title: Do not say 'Who will ascend into heaven?'; the word is near
speaker: Moses' words, applied by Paul
note: Applies Deuteronomy 30:12–14 (with 9:4's 'do not say in your heart') to the word of faith.

title: Do not be wise in your own eyes over Israel's hardening
speaker: Paul
note: 11:25 discloses the mystery so they will not be conceited, extending the 'do not boast' warning.

title: Repay no one evil for evil, and do not avenge yourselves
speaker: Paul
topic: Minor Teachings: The Scriptures Read in Christ
note: 12:17a is the same non-retaliation directive as 12:19; compare A018 (1 Peter 3:9).

title: As far as it depends on you, live at peace with all
speaker: Paul
note: Also 12:17b: take thought for what is honorable before all people. Compare A093 (Hebrews 12:14).

title: Do not be conquered by evil, but conquer evil with good
speaker: Paul
topic: Major Teachings: The Word of Christ Handed On
note: A017's title already names overcoming evil with good (12:21), but its reference is only 12:14.

title: Submit to authorities for conscience' sake and pay taxes and dues
speaker: Paul
topic: Major Teachings: The Word of Christ Handed On
note: A050's title names payment of what is owed (13:6–7) but cites only 13:1; compare K078 (render to Caesar).

title: Do not let your good be spoken of as evil
speaker: Paul
topic: Major Teachings: The Word of Christ Handed On
note: 14:16 lies between A027's 14:13–15 and its linked 14:19–23.

title: God's kingdom is not food and drink but righteousness, peace and joy
speaker: Paul
topic: Major Teachings: The Word of Christ Handed On
note: A033's title describes the 14:17 contrast but cites only 14:14.

title: Paul serves as Christ's priestly minister of the gospel to the Gentiles
speaker: Paul
note: Restates the 1:1–6 commission (obedience of faith among the nations); 15:13 is a blessing, 15:14 a commendation.

title: Those who share in spiritual blessings owe service in material things
speaker: Paul
note: Rationale for the Gentile churches' gift to Jerusalem's poor; compare AUD-50-16-1 and A083 (1 Corinthians 9:11).

title: Paul asks the Romans to send him onward to Spain
speaker: Paul
topic: Historical commissions, journeys and public life
note: 'Sent onward' implies travel support; same request at 1 Corinthians 16:6 and 2 Corinthians 1:16; compare AUD-60-3-13.

title: Greet Prisca, Aquila and the other named believers in Rome
speaker: Paul
topic: Major Teachings: The Word of Christ Handed On
note: Named greetings leading into Romans 16:16, which is already linked to this record.

title: Paul proclaims Christ crucified without persuasive words of wisdom
speaker: Paul
note: Paul describes fulfilling the 1:17 charge 'without wisdom of speech' so faith rests on God's power; 2:6–16 is doctrine.

title: Jealousy and quarrels over Paul and Apollos are fleshly
speaker: Paul
note: Same rebuke of party slogans as 1:10–13; 4:6–7 is already linked to this record.

title: Imitate apostles who bless when insulted and endure when persecuted
speaker: Paul
note: 4:12–13 describes the conduct Paul then urges them to imitate (4:16); 4:8–10 is ironic rebuke.

title: Paul warns the arrogant: shall I come with a rod or gentleness?
speaker: Paul
recipient: the Corinthian church, especially the arrogant
note: Closes the 4:14–17 admonition; 'God's kingdom is in power, not in talk' (4:20).

title: Knowledge puffs up, but love builds up
speaker: Paul
note: Includes 8:2–3: one who thinks he knows does not yet know as he ought; one who loves God is known by Him.

title: An idol is nothing; food does not commend us to God
speaker: Paul
topic: Major Teachings: The Word of Christ Handed On
note: Premise of 8:9–13 (linked to A027); parallels Romans 14:14,17 on food and God's kingdom.

title: Ministers may claim material support, like soldiers, planters and shepherds
speaker: Paul
topic: Minor Teachings: The Scriptures Read in Christ
note: 9:4–7 states the right and its everyday analogies, which 9:8–11 grounds in the threshing-ox law.

title: Forgo your rights rather than hinder the good news
speaker: Paul
note: 9:12b states the renunciation that 9:15–23 explains; 9:13–14 is A047.

title: Imitate me, just as I also imitate Christ
speaker: Paul
topic: Major Teachings: The Word of Christ Handed On
note: Same command as 4:16; it also concludes 10:23–33 (AUD-50-10-23).

title: Varied gifts come from one Spirit for the common good
speaker: Paul
note: 12:7 ('for the common benefit') frames the body teaching of 12:12–31; compare AUD-49-12-3.

title: Paul quotes 'Let us eat and drink, for tomorrow we die'
speaker: Paul, quoting Isaiah 22:13
topic: Minor Teachings: The Scriptures Read in Christ
note: Cited as the outcome if the dead are not raised; AUD-50-15-1 (15:33–34) rebukes it. Rest of 15:3–57 is doctrine.

title: Paul urged Apollos to visit Corinth, but he declined for now
speaker: Paul
topic: Historical commissions, journeys and public life
note: Reported request; Apollos will come when he has opportunity.

title: Comfort others with the comfort you receive from God
speaker: Paul
note: Praise of God stating a principle for conduct (1:4): comfort received equips us to comfort the afflicted.

title: Rely on God who raises the dead, and help by prayer
speaker: Paul
note: 1:9 draws the lesson of trust from affliction; 1:11 counts on the Corinthians' intercession (compare AUD-49-15-30).

title: Do not lord it over others' faith; work for their joy
speaker: Paul
note: Echoes 1 Peter 5:3 ('not lording it over those allotted to you'), stated as Paul's own practice.

title: Do not peddle God's word; speak sincerely as sent from God
speaker: Paul
note: Same principle as 4:2 (not tampering with the word of God).

title: God made us sufficient as ministers of a new covenant
speaker: Paul
note: Statement of appointment by God, like the ministry of reconciliation given in 5:18; 3:6b 'the letter kills' is doctrine.

title: Afflicted but not crushed: carry Jesus' dying so his life appears
speaker: Paul
note: 4:7–15 is the hardship from which 4:16 ('therefore we do not lose heart') draws its conclusion.

title: Walk by faith, not by sight, longing for the heavenly dwelling
speaker: Paul
note: 5:1–8 continues 4:16–18 on the unseen and eternal across the chapter break.

title: Make it your aim to please the Lord before Christ's judgment seat
speaker: Paul
note: All must appear before Christ's judgment seat to receive for what they have done (5:10); 5:12–13 needs nothing.

title: Regard no one according to the flesh; in Christ is new creation
speaker: Paul
note: Doctrine with a direction on how to regard people; borderline.

title: Give no cause for stumbling; commend yourselves as God's ministers
speaker: Paul
note: 6:3–10 continues the 6:1 appeal, describing ministers' blameless endurance; largely a model to imitate.

title: Open your hearts wide to us and make room for us
speaker: Paul
topic: Major Teachings: The Word of Christ Handed On
note: AUD-51-6-14 (6:14–7:1) interrupts; 7:2 resumes the appeal. 7:4–7 and 7:12–16 are autobiography.

title: Rejected at Corinth, Paul turns to the Gentiles
speaker: Paul
note: Outside candidate list; the same turn to the Gentiles as 13:46–47, with the sign of shaking out his garments.

title: God's salvation has been sent to the Gentiles; they will listen
speaker: Paul
note: Closing declaration after Isaiah 6:9–10 (linked to ot-isaiah-v6-8), echoing the 13:46–47 turn to the Gentiles.

title: Set your mind on the Spirit, not the flesh, and live
speaker: Paul
note: 8:5–8 contrasts the two mindsets that ground the 8:12–13 directive; 8:9–11 is doctrine.

title: Present sufferings are not worth comparing with the glory to come
speaker: Paul
note: Same teaching as 2 Corinthians 4:17–18 (momentary affliction, unseen eternal glory); 8:24–25 awaits unseen hope with perseverance.

summary: Acts 17:27–2 Corinthians 7:16: 42 new, 20 extend, 22 parallel; main gaps are unrecorded trial and custody orders in Acts 21–25, Paul's reported call to repentance (Acts 26:20), mis-scoped Romans 12–14 records (A017, A050, A033, A086, A027), 1 Corinthians 8:1–3, and the 2 Corinthians 6:11–13/7:2 appeal.
